description: Updates dependencies in the lock file. Optionally updates a single package.

aggressive.description: Force updating all dependencies of the specified package as well (--aggressive)

dryRun.description: Preview what would be updated without modifying the lock file (--dry-run)

frozen.description: Require Cargo.lock and cache are up to date (--frozen)

locked.description: Require Cargo.lock is up to date (--locked)

package.description: Specific package to update (e.g. 'serde'). Omit to update all.

precise.description: Update to exactly this version (--precise <VERSION>). Requires a package to be specified.

workspace.description: Update all packages in the workspace (--workspace)

name: update
title: Cargo Update
